title: Coefficient work budget
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, define the coefficient work budget to be the small-bias generator work plus the sample count, plus the active cap at the threshold multiplied by the local work per coefficient.
caveat: The component budgets and the input fields used in this definition are not defined in the supplied material, so their precise meanings cannot be made self-contained.
